note: Adapted from Ahmad's (1965) original species-level description, originally in English; the original describes only the soldier (1 holotype, with workers accompanying it), measurements in mm. Type locality Tung Sa-Lang Luang, Thailand, collected on 8 April 1962 (day 8, month 4) from soil under wood. It is distinguished from all known species of the genus by the left mandible being distinctly longer than the head capsule.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale brown with red, the middle of the labrum brownish and its sides transparent, mandibles dark red-brown, antennae brown with a whitish apical segment. Head with sparse hairs, the apex of the labrum with a few hairs, the anterior margin of the postmentum with 2 hairs, the pronotum sparsely hairy. Head slightly squarish, its length only slightly greater than its width; posterior margin concave, depressed in the middle; coronal suture distinct, extending to the middle of the head; frontal process indistinct. Labrum distinctly longer than wide, the anterior margin deeply concave, the anterolateral corners produced into long slender processes. Mandibles slender, slightly asymmetrical. Postmentum moderately arched, distinctly narrowed a little below the middle, widest above the middle. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 slightly shorter than segment 3 and not distinctly longer than segment 4. Pronotum without notches on either the anterior or the posterior margin, the lateral lobes distinct and narrowly rounded. Measurements of the holotype soldier (mm): head length to the lateral antennal base 1.19, head width 1.04, labrum median length 0.39, width 0.20, left mandible length 1.50, postmentum length 0.54, postmentum maximum width 0.31, minimum width 0.23, pronotum 0.23 × 0.54.
